§6Assembly Machine§f

§aWelcome to the factory. This thing builds everything from here on out.§f

The §bAssembly Machine§f is a 3×3 pseudo-multiblock that crafts most advanced machines in the game. Pick a recipe via the blue folder button, feed it power (HE), and load the materials.

Craft it at a Tier 2 (steel) anvil: steel ingots ×8, copper plates ×4, motors ×2, vacuum tubes ×4. Duplicating from another assembly machine is cheaper.

Some recipes need a §bblueprint§f in the blueprint slot. Blueprint booklets spawn in structures, right-click to consume and get a random one.

§ePS:§f Power it with a wood-burning generator or stirling engine to get started.
